Dear {vendor} team,

We are writing to dispute charges on {agreement}. Our commitment under this agreement covers {contracted_seats} seats, but {invoices} bills us for {billed_seats} seats.

The agreement states: "{seat_clause}" We have not signed any written order form increasing our seats, so the {extra_seats} additional seats are not authorized under the agreement. At {price_per_seat}, the extra seats add {overcharge_monthly} per month, and the amount overcharged to date is {overcharged_to_date}. Left uncorrected, the difference would total {annualized} over a year.

Please issue a credit for the overcharged amount of {overcharged_to_date} and send a corrected bill reflecting {contracted_seats} seats going forward. If you believe a written order form exists that authorizes the additional seats, please send a copy so we can review it.

Thank you for your prompt attention to this matter. We look forward to your reply.

Best regards,
{sender}
